decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler stays close to the core air-cooling business and costs little to keep listed, and two years of results are still too few to resolve its value in long industrial project cycles, so the option stays open.
Dropping the sibling condenser C removed the overlap, so B now carries that market segment on shared resources, and keeping it remains cheap while its value is still unclear.
The tube liner is a low-cost lifecycle service product with upside in repair and extension of heat exchanger life, so holding the option stays worthwhile.
The customized air cooler line fits the firm's integrated-solutions strategy and offers several models as paths to further investment, so it merits continued commitment.
The tube end repair inserts support the spare parts and repair business at minimal holding cost and fit the move toward lifecycle services, so the option is kept open.
